title: Art, Culture & Institutions
intro: Art and culture questions reward recognition: matching a classical dance to its home state, a heritage site to its city, a sport to its terms, or a famous book to its author. The facts are concrete and unchanging. The smart approach is to learn them in pairs — dance↔state, site↔location, author↔book — so a single cue retrieves the answer.

topics.name: Dance, Music & Art Forms
topics.details: India's eight classical dances and their homes: Bharatanatyam (Tamil Nadu), Kathak (North India/UP), Kathakali & Mohiniyattam (Kerala), Kuchipudi (Andhra Pradesh), Odissi (Odisha), Manipuri (Manipur), Sattriya (Assam). Classical music splits into Hindustani (north) and Carnatic (south).

solved.problem: Bharatanatyam is the classical dance of which state?
Kathakali and Mohiniyattam belong to which state?
Which classical dance is associated with Odisha?
Garba is a folk dance of which state?

unsolved.problem: Kuchipudi is the classical dance of which state?
Bhangra is a folk dance of?
Sattriya dance belongs to which state?
The two main schools of Indian classical music are Hindustani and ___.
Manipuri dance is from which state?

topics.name: UNESCO & Heritage Sites
topics.details: India has many UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Match the monument to its city/state — that is the typical question form.

solved.problem: In which city is the Taj Mahal located?
The Sun Temple at Konark is in which state?
The Ajanta and Ellora Caves are in which state?
Hampi (Vijayanagara ruins) is in which state?

unsolved.problem: The Khajuraho temples are in which state?
The Qutb Minar is located in?
Konark's Sun Temple is in which state?
The Red Fort is located in?
The Taj Mahal stands on the bank of which river?

topics.name: Sports & Awards
topics.details: Know which terms belong to which sport, and the national sports awards (Khel Ratna, Arjuna, Dronacharya). Major events: Olympics (every 4 years), FIFA World Cup, ICC Cricket World Cup.

solved.problem: The terms "googly" and "yorker" belong to which sport?
India's highest sporting honour is named after which player?
"Checkmate" is a term from which game?
The Olympics are held once every how many years?

unsolved.problem: "Deuce" is a term used in?
The Dronacharya Award is given to sports ___.
The FIFA World Cup is associated with which sport?
"Birdie" and "putt" belong to which sport?
Dhyan Chand was a legend of which sport?

topics.name: Books & Authors
topics.details: Match famous works to their authors — a recurring SSC item. Tagore wrote the national anthems of both India and Bangladesh.

solved.problem: "My Experiments with Truth" is the autobiography of whom?

unsolved.problem: "Arthashastra" was written by?
Rabindranath Tagore won the Nobel Prize in which year?
The author of "Discovery of India" is?
"Wings of Fire" was written by which former President?
Tagore wrote the national anthems of India and ___.

shortcuts: Learn culture facts as pairs — dance↔state, site↔city, author↔book.
Kerala has two classical dances (Kathakali, Mohiniyattam); Tamil Nadu has Bharatanatyam.
Sport from the term: googly/yorker → cricket, deuce → tennis, checkmate → chess.
Khel Ratna = Dhyan Chand (hockey); highest cinema honour = Dadasaheb Phalke.
Tagore = Gitanjali + India's & Bangladesh's anthems + 1913 Nobel.
mistakes: Placing a heritage site in the wrong state.
Confusing the Khel Ratna with the Arjuna/Dronacharya awards.
Attributing a book to the wrong author.
pyq: SSC asks dance-state and monument-location matches, sport-from-term items, and a book-author pairing nearly every Tier 1. Paired memorisation makes these quick, certain marks.
summary: Art and culture is paired recognition: classical dances to their states, heritage sites to their cities, sports to their terms, and books to their authors. Memorise the pairs SSC repeats and a single cue will retrieve the answer — fast, certain marks.
